Title: Undo last movement
Description: As a player, I want to undo the last movement so that I can correct mistakes during the current level.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Save the current game
Description: As a player, I want to save my current game so that I can continue later.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Load Saved Game
Description: As a player, I want to load a previously saved game so that I can continue playing later.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Detect invalid levels
Description: As a player, I want invalid levels to be detected automatically so that the game only loads correct boards.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Show invalid level error messages
Description: As a player, I want error messages to appear when a level is invalid.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Save undo movement history
Description: As a player, I want undo history to be preserved after saving/loading the game.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Preserve scores after save/load
Description: As a player, I want scores to remain unchanged after loading a saved game.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Open saved game from menu
Description: As a player, I want a menu option to open saved games.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Save game from menu
Description: As a player, I want a menu option to save the game.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Improve graphical appearance
Description: As a player, I want an attractive interface so that the game is easier and nicer to play.
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Implement level validator
Description: Validate all conditions of a level specified in the norms
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO

Title: Create key shortcuts to save game
Author: HERNÁNDEZ SÁNCHEZ, ALEJANDRO
